description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Attach Lightning], [Awoken Witch], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Play Rough Mode] to the user

description.name: Awoken Witch
description.text: Witch abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Witch abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Attach Lightning
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Lightning damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Lightning resistance +20%

description.name: Play Rough Mode
description.text: MAG +30%, DEF and RES -30%, cast speed x3.00
